firstPlayerRule: Whoever has the pointiest ears takes the first turn. Continue clockwise around the table.
houseFallback: If this criterion does not suit your group, agree to choose randomly. This is a house rule.
clarifications: The same first player advances the game-turn marker when a new round begins.
